verdict.rationale: Postman's docs say Spec Hub lets you design an API's structure, which supports spec-first design. The CLI can also lint API schemas and check specifications against governance rules. However, nothing in the pack names OpenAPI as a supported format or describes exporting a designed spec as OpenAPI, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit OpenAPI format support in Spec Hub, documented export to an OpenAPI file, independent or hands-on corroboration of the design-then-export workflow.
